Parliament Speaker Mohammad Bagher Ghalibaf says Iran “must push the enemy back and deal devastating blows using our full military might” before any negotiations with the United States.
Tehran’s top security official Mohsen Rezaei tells Al Jazeera it has conveyed its conditions for resuming talks to the White House through Qatari mediators.
